transcript.message:
Hi, this is Sarah calling from Acme Financial — thanks for picking up. I completely understand you're busy, and I appreciate you taking a moment. I’ll keep this quick, but I wanted to reach out about your account. 

If now isn’t a good time, I’d be happy to call back — do you have a better time later today or tomorrow when we could talk for just 5 minutes? I know things get hectic, and I’d like to find a time that works for you so we can go over your options and see what kind of plan might work with your schedule.

No pressure — I just want to make sure we can connect when you’re not rushed. Would later this evening or maybe first thing tomorrow work better?
